_note: Lib-agnostic source catalog extracted from the S578 prototype. Nested keys work as-is with next-intl namespaces or a plain lookup helper. {name} is a runtime interpolation (the channel name). Keep operator-facing strings ONLY here; no string ships as a literal in the UI.

stage1.title: Link your portals
stage1.sub: Connect each website one time. After that, Vacantless can post your listing for you.
stage1.kindLogin: You log in with your own account

status.linkedSub: Ready to automatically send your listings.
status.notLinkedSub: Connect once and we can post here for you.
status.notAvailableSub: We are still building this connection. Nothing to do here yet.
status.mlsOnlySub: Realtor.ca is not a direct post. We prepare the sheet for your agent.

buttons.login: CLICK HERE TO LOG IN WITH YOUR {name} PASSWORD

stage1.igNote: Needs a Facebook Page with a linked Instagram Business account.

stage2.title: Add property details
stage2.sub: Give us the details one time. We fill every website for you. Pick one way to start.
stage2.cardEmailBody: Send any notes or a draft to your private Vacantless address.
stage2.cardDocBody: Drag in an old lease, a PDF brochure, or an MLS sheet.
stage2.cardManualBody: Fill a simple form by hand.
stage2.readTitle: What the computer has read so far
stage2.pickPrompt: Pick one way to start above, and the details will appear here.

stage3.title: Choose & send live
stage3.sub: Review once, then send to every connected website at the same time.
stage3.onlyLinked: We only send to the websites you have linked. The rest stay off until they are ready.
stage3.blast: CLICK HERE TO SEND THIS LISTING TO ALL PORTALS NOW
stage3.sending: Sending now — please keep this screen open
stage3.allDone: All done. Your listing is live everywhere it can be.

stage4.title: After it is live
stage4.sub: This is what publish-only tools cannot show you: the leads coming back, and the ad turning itself off when the home is leased.
stage4.leadsBody: Every reply from every website comes back to one place.
stage4.takedownBody: When the home is leased, Vacantless removes each ad for you. No forgotten live ads.
stage4.leasedDone: Leased. Vacantless is removing your ads now.
